evidence.detail: decks_order_by appends hardcoded secondary sorts (d.finish ASC, cache.active_date DESC) regardless of prior user sort — no dynamic memory of previous sort columns
cards_order_by similarly uses fixed secondary tiebreakers; the user's previous sort choice is never threaded through as a secondary column

triage.notes: Feature is still absent. Implementing it requires the frontend to track sort history across column clicks and pass multiple sort params to the API, then clauses.py to compose them — cross-layer change too large for easy-fix.
